office-desk-slime.title: Is Your Office Desk Secretly a Slime Swamp?
office-desk-slime.author: Giggle McSilly
office-desk-slime.content: Science reveals that 9 out of 10 desks left unattended for over 48 hours begin to grow microscopic bounce-house particles. We investigate the mysterious sticky syrup behind your keyboard, why your favorite pen keeps walking towards the break room, and how to negotiate a peace treaty with the dust bunny under your CPU...

ai-cat-legs.title: How to Prompt AI to Draw a Cat with 12 Legs
ai-cat-legs.author: Pixel Prankster
ai-cat-legs.content: We spent 24 straight hours asking neural networks to depict a standard tabby cat, but with exactly 12 legs. The results were: a multi-legged caterpillar cat, an abstract spider-kitten, and a server room crash in Munich. Read on for the full prompt recipes that will puzzle artificial programmers and wow your group chats!
